repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhshTXCAmv9KJXRZkB ## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T05:03Z L1: REWORK Head-sha: 338d995bed724fd1255ecc688297ba4495c853e9 Card: #34590 · claim 6937435512 + scope amendment 6937557056 + surface extension 6937657477 · ruling 6937542160 · os-dev-report 6938587078 The code change is right and follows the ruling. One published doc page states the superseded order, so this PR cannot land as is. ### Must-fix 1. **`content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` § "The synthesized default" now describes the old order in two places.** - Lines 183–185: "a right column of panels: **动态** (Activity) first, then the related lists, **Approvals** when the record has approval requests, and the attachments …". After this PR the right column reads: related panels, then attachments, then approvals, then 动态 last (`RecordPageColumns.tsx`: `RelatedCardStack`, then `RecordTimelinePanel`). The doc's relative order of Approvals and attachments was already off; it should match the new sentence. - Lines 193–194: "a row of tabs … **Overview** first, then **动态**, then one tab per related panel in the reader's order". After this PR the order is Overview, the panel tabs, then 动态 last. - The checklist says a published defect this round makes false is fixed in the same PR. `content/docs/**` is outside the claim surface and its two extensions (which admit only assertion-only test edits), so the area amends the claim to add `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`, and the PR body names the amendment. - At this head, `git grep -nEi "动态|record:timeline|Activity stream" content/docs skills` finds no other order statement. `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` names the panel and the tab but no order. ### Should-fix (same round, if the claim amendment takes them) 2. The PR body's Acceptance notes list three source comments this PR makes false, all outside the claim surface: - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordTabRow.tsx` (~:86): "动态 first, then the related panels"; - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (~:4996): "(动态, then the related panels)"; - `RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx` (~:695): "the first panel of the right column". They are comment-only and cheap to fix in the same amendment. If the area prefers to leave them, keep the note; they are not an L1 bar. ### Readings that hold | Item | Reading | |:--|:--| | PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34590`, which is correct after ruling 6937542160 dropped item 2 and the claim scope amendment 6937557056. No other closing verb in the body (`#27524`, `#28469`, `#27055` stand verb-free). No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. | | Scope | 16 files. Source: `RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` and `synth/recordPageColumns.ts` (prose only), all in the surface. The tests under `plugin-detail/src/**/__tests__/` are in the surface. The two app-shell tests and the showcase e2e are in extension 6937657477, and their diffs are assertion and comment edits only. No source file is outside the surface. | | Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `no` / `none`, matching the claim. No key is added, and tab `value`s are unchanged (`details` / `related` / `approvals` / `timeline`), so `?tab=` links still resolve. `buildDefaultTabs` is exported from published `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`src/index.tsx:193`), and only its output order moves; the changeset tells splicing authors to find their place by `value`. That is not an accept-set change, so no L2 is owed. | | Ruling fidelity | Ruling 6937542160 (「同意」): no object-level key (none added); 动态 last in the right column, the stack and the narrow-screen tab row (all three done); #27524 Targets 5 and 8 named as superseded in the body and in every changed source comment. Card acceptance 1 (wide right column: related, attachments, 动态) is met, with approvals between when present. Acceptance 2 (375 px: 动态 at the bottom) is met by the stack order and pinned. | | Changeset | Names `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. Sentences read against the diff:
• "right column reads related panels, then attachments, then approvals, then Activity" = `RelatedCardStack` (attachments and approvals close the related set) before `RecordTimelinePanel`.
• "one-column … Activity at the very bottom" = the same aside order in the stack tier.
• "tab row: Overview, the related panels, then Activity … waits off the row … no tab moves" = `timelineHeld = hasTimeline && firstPanelSetOut && activeTab !== RECORD_PAGE_TIMELINE_PANEL`, with the row still drawn through `+ (timelineHeld ? 1 : 0)`.
• "synthesized strip: Details, Related, Approvals, then the Activity stream" = the timeline `items.push` moved after approvals.
• "hand-written page keeps its order; values unchanged" = no other hunk.
All true. | | No-move rule (#28469 Target 2) | The held 动态 tab keeps the row from shifting while the first count set is out, and is drawn at once when it is the active tab. Ablation 2 shows the pins catch its removal. | | Updated old-order pins | Each one cites #34590 / ruling 6937542160 and inverts only the order; I spot-read `RecordTabRow.recordsFirst-28469` and `buildDefaultPageSchema.test`. The first describe of `RecordTabRow.recordsFirst-28469` (fixed tab list, width rule) is untouched, which is correct. | | Tests | Real commands with output: 11 changed files / 175 tests on the head, plugin-detail 380 files / 3428 tests, app-shell consumers 110 files. Two ablations, each restored to the HEAD blob. `dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, needs `dist`); it is CI's. | | Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34643`: NOT governed, 0 of 16 paths, 396 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-A. | | CI | Requester reports 45 `success` / 10 `skipped` on this head. I will read the check-runs myself on the docs head at the delta ACCEPT, since that push supersedes this head. | ### Notes - On a narrow row with many panels, 动态 can now fold into the 「+N ▾」 menu (declared). That follows from 「动态在最后」 under the existing fit rule; no action. - After the docs push, send the new head: I owe a delta read (the docs sentences, the claim amendment and CI on that head), not a full re-review.
